title: Bug: GCU test_replace_fec fails in multi-asic due to namespace parameter missing from cli call
author: okaravasi
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

Test fails for multi-asic platform due to new code added via https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/pull/19341 and has only single-asic support.
`config interface` command needs to take namespace in case of multi-asic platform.

Failure is seen only on multi-asic platforms.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run test generic_config_updater.test_eth_interface::test_replace_fec in any multi-asic platform.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`config interface` command needs to be updated to use namespace argument in case of running in multi-asic device.
right now doesn not.
